test_title: PYST 08: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a circular table with their backs facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). J is sitting to the immediate left of G. K is sitting to the immediate right of E. H is sitting to the immediate right of K. I is sitting to the immediate right of H and immediate left of F. F is sitting to the immediate left of J. Who is an immediate neighbour of both E and J?
solution:
**Given**: E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a circular table with their backs facing the centre.

Based on the given conditions in the question, we get the following arrangements-

1. J is sitting to the immediate left of G. F is sitting to the immediate left of J. From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f407d4e50c4483a27d403db55bb629e6b4b8f6f3041dffd5a7305ba5418485a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426a4e56ba8199c1e0541f767d4aecd9d79d55692ff3ed2507700ee622ca81d9.png] 

2. I is sitting to the immediate right of H and immediate left of F. K is sitting to the immediate right of E. H is sitting to the immediate right of K. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b86096cbfe2b4d351a41edabd5ac6e2816d95d58513429acd949400436c02f6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab9ef8313b8b41ec0c9f1b269a0b1d26d014efd21f8469824636e913ed73383.png] 

Therefore, we see that G is an immediate neighbor of both E and J.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**’.
